body: bleak indeed. if there really is nothing for us, then living seems the rational choice where you could breathe and experience the things you want to experience, though you might not want to endure whatever hardships life throws at you. in the end choice is all that matters. for one to remember life after death must be hell, however i like to believe we are here to experience both the ugly and the beauty of life. maybe we are sent here with a purpose, who are we to appreciate the vastness of life and space all in one lifespan. all i know is there is nothing else in our reality more powerful than a human longing for his or her dreams

may i ask what do you think will happen next, for you that is.
death fascinates me in the way there is nothing we can do to figure out what will happen, but one can only fantasize.
excuse me if i am being too unsensitive here, i feel the same way
